{{Quote|Kiera Swan, two-time winner of the Obsidian Sphere.|Count Dooku|audio=ObsidianSphere-TheBox.flac|<ref name="Box">{{TCW|The Box}}</ref>}}
[[File:KieraSwan-SWE.png|thumb|right|200px|Kiera Swan, two-time winner of the Obsidian Sphere]]
The '''Obsidian Sphere''' was a competition that the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Kiera Swan/Legends|Kiera Swan]] won twice<ref name="Box" /> by [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="21BBY">{{FactFile2014|57|EVA 1-2|Moralo Eval}} dates the events of "[[The Box]]" to [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].</ref> [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] invited multiple [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]] to participate in a [[Tournament on Serenno/Legends|tournament]]<ref name="Box" /> he<ref name="Dooku">{{SWE|characters|dooku|Count Dooku}}</ref> hosted on<ref name="Box" /> his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]<ref name="Dooku" /> [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]]. Swan was present for the event, and the [[Count/Legends|Count]] referenced<ref name="Box" /> her<ref name="Trivia Gallery">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep417|text="The Box" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}} {{C|Trivia Gallery: slide 2}}</ref> achievements in the Obsidian Sphere when introducing the bounty hunters to each other.<ref name="Box" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Obsidian Sphere was first mentioned in "[[The Box]],"<ref name="Box" /> the seventeenth episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|fourth season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' animated television series, which premiered on [[February 3]], [[2012]].<ref name="EpG">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide]]''</ref> The names of both the competition and Kiera Swan reference the [[Wikipedia:Pirates of the Caribbean|''Pirates of the Caribbean'']] franchise, which features the [[Wikipedia:Black Pearl|''Black Pearl'']] pirate ship and the character [[Wikipedia:Elizabeth Swann|Elizabeth Swann]], who is played by [[Keira Knightley]].<ref name="Trivia Gallery" />
